text_blocks.snippet: The Delta variant, officially known as B.1.617.2, was a highly transmissible variant of SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19. First detected in India in October 2020, it quickly became dominant worldwide, spreading to over 179 countries by November 2021. The World Health Organization (WHO) designated it as a variant of concern in June 2021 due to its increased transmissibility.
